title: Electric Service Agreement Due Dates, Grace Periods and Late Payment Charge Values by Schedule
content:
Each Electric Service Agreement rate schedule sets how long a customer has to pay a bill, how long the grace period after the due date runs, the late payment charge rate and minimum, and the courtesy waiver allowance.

## Meaning of each value

- **Bill due days** — calendar days from the bill date to the due date printed on the bill.
- **Late payment grace days** — calendar days after the due date before a late payment charge may be posted. A value of 0 means no grace days follow the due date.
- **Late payment charge rate** — a one-time fraction of the unpaid portion of a bill.
- **Late payment charge minimum** — the smallest late payment charge per bill when a charge applies, in USD.
- **Courtesy waivers per 12 months** — the number of late payment charges that may be waived as a courtesy within any rolling 12 months; 0 means no courtesy waiver.
- **Clean-history months** — the months before the waived charge's posting date that must contain no other late payment charge and no returned payment for a courtesy waiver.

## Schedule values

Columns: RS is Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, RT is Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service, REV is Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service, GS is Schedule GS Small General Service, GST is Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service, GD is Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service and LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

| Term | RS | RT | REV | GS | GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days from bill date to due date | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 17 | 15 |
| Late payment grace period, calendar days after the due date | 5 | 5 | 5 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 0 |
| Late payment charge rate (one time, on the unpaid portion of a bill) | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% | 1.5% | 2% | 2% |
| Late payment charge minimum, USD per bill | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| Courtesy late-charge waivers per rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Courtesy waiver clean-history months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |

## Points of comparison

- The residential schedules (RS, RT, REV) share a 21-day due period, a 5-day grace period, a 1.5% rate and a 1.00 USD minimum.
- The small general schedules (GS, GST) keep 21 days and 1.5% but have a 3-day grace period and a 2.00 USD minimum.
- Schedule GD has a 17-day due period, 3 grace days, a 2% rate and a 5.00 USD minimum; Schedule LP has a 15-day due period, no grace days, a 2% rate and a 25.00 USD minimum.
- Schedule LP is the only schedule with no courtesy waiver (0 per 12 months); every other schedule allows 1.

Hypothetical illustration: a Schedule GS bill dated on day 1 of a month is due 21 calendar days later, on day 22; its 3 grace days are days 23, 24 and 25.
